definitions.explanation: Directed at people outside a group, or at other countries: how an organization presents itself to outsiders, or a nation's foreign relations.

examples.japanese: {対外的|たいがいてき}な⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧。
examples.english: An official announcement to the outside.

examples.japanese: {対外的|たいがいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}ない→問題ない：26594_mondainai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: Externally, they explained that there was no problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧もめて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{対外的|たいがいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一致|いっち}している→一致する：19648_icchisuru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}せている→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: They are quarrelling internally but presenting a united front to the outside.

notes:
⟦{対外|たいがい}→対外：33196_taigai⟧ (external, foreign) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対外的|たいがいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: outwardly, to the outside world
- {対外的|たいがいてき}な⟦イメージ→イメージ：03832_imeeji⟧: public image
- {対外的|たいがいてき}な⟦{信用|しんよう}→信用：03267_shinyou⟧: credibility with outsiders

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {対内的|たいないてき}: internal, the opposite
- ⟦{表向|おもてむ}き→表向き：17918_omotemuki⟧: on the surface, ostensibly; stresses the gap with reality
